name: Top Gear: Caravan Crush
summary:
The official BBC Top Gear Game!

Start your engines and crush as many caravans as you can in Top Gear’s Caravan Crush, the ultimate car-to-caravan faceoff. Brace for Top Gear's dry taste for destruction, British Banter and, of course, The Stig.

Join in our collective contempt for caravans, with the topmost game for those stints of boredom when there's nothing better to do than explode caravans with souped-up vehicles.
